title: Rational Design of a Lanthanide-Based Complex Featuring Different Single-Molecule Magnets

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear Dy4 assembly of two terminal mononuclear Dy(tta)3 units bridged by a central dinuclear Dy2(tta)6 core

synthesis.procedure: Dy(tta)3·2H2O (34.4 mg, 0.04 mmol) was dissolved in CH2Cl2 (10 mL) and added to a solution of L (12.5 mg, 0.02 mmol) in CH2Cl2 (10 mL). After 15 min of stirring, the solution was layered with 25 mL of n-hexane at room temperature in the dark. Slow diffusion afforded red single crystals suitable for X-ray studies.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: layered with 25 mL n-hexane; slow diffusion gave red single crystals

properties.summary: Tetranuclear SMM combining two terminal mononuclear Dy SMMs and a central antiferromagnetically coupled dinuclear Dy2 SMM. Room-temperature χMT is 56 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 56.7 for four DyIII). Zero-field ac susceptibility is frequency-dependent below 14 K and splits below 10 K into fast (mononuclear) and slow (dinuclear) relaxation processes that merge above ~7 K. A magnetic hysteresis loop opens at 0.5 K.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: room temperature; expected 56.7 cm3 K mol−1 for four DyIII (6H15/2)

measurements.name: out-of-phase ac susceptibility (SMM)
measurements.value: frequency-dependent signal below 14 K; FR/SR split below 10 K
measurements.conditions: zero external dc field; ac frequency range 10−2–103 Hz

measurements.name: Hcross (dinuclear interaction)
measurements.conditions: related to J by Hcross = −J/2gβ with g = 20, giving J ≈ −2.8 cm−1

measurements.name: magnetic hysteresis loop
measurements.value: slightly open at 0.5 K; not open at 2 K
measurements.conditions: 0.5 K (Figure 9); relaxation times too fast for opening at 2 K
